g.text: Wiring schematic: BLUE WAVE, WLtoys 1:28 chassis with Raspberry Pi 5, RRC Lite and Cytron MD13S

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5a6b80

g.text: Pin values from src/profiles/wltoys_bw2.json, which the code reads. Lines: red = battery +, black = ground, orange = 5 V, blue = signal, purple = USB, grey dashed = charge lead.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5a6b80

g.text: The motor current returns through the MD13S power negative, not through the Pi's signal ground. The RRC Lite's motor ports are not used. The start button uses the Pi's internal pull-up.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #5a6b80
